data.reason_zh: LLM代理以执行反馈改写联合调度策略代码，有效变体存入策略库并在后续episode选用，具备反馈驱动与继承性。

scope_support.feedback_quote: uses execution feedback to revise the code
scope_support.object_quote: a framework in which a large language model (LLM) agent uses execution feedback to revise the code of joint scheduling policies
scope_support.persistence_quote: SatCraft retains valid alternatives in a policy library and selects one for each episode using initial access observations and the known resource configuration.
